data: Which of the models have a source contribution entropy greater than 2.992 at target token position 15?

The question asks which models have a source contribution entropy greater than 2.992 at target token position 15. From the caption, we know that Figure 5 shows results for random prefixes, and the figure includes two subfigures: (a) contribution of source and (b) entropy of source contributions. The relevant subfigure is (b), which displays the entropy of source contributions.

Looking at subfigure (b), we can see that the baseline model has an entropy value slightly above 2.992 at target token position 15. The other models (wd, source, wd, target, and MRT) also have similar values, but none of them exceed 2.992 at this position.

Therefore, the only model with a source contribution entropy greater than 2.992 at target token position 15 is the baseline model.
